notes: Sylhet Metropolitan Police thana (SMP এক নজরে: "Kotwali Model Thana"; Bangla name as on SMP's home page: "কোতোয়ালী মডেল থানা, সিলেট"). SMP says its area includes "27 wards of Sylhet City Corporation, 08 Unions of Sylhet Sadar Upazila and 10 Unions of South Surma Upazilla" (https://police.sylhetdiv.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/696ca219c4774958d7b931b6, updated 2022-08-27 17:01) but does not say which thana covers which wards or unions; Sylhet City Corporation (now 42 wards, https://scc.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/6922df09933eb65569e1f5f4) names no thanas. No official source places an SMP thana in the city corporation, so none is placed (area_en empty).
